name: adaptyv
description: Curated Adaptyv/ProteinBase de novo binder pool, 4 targets (EGFR, IL7R, Nipah glycoprotein G, PD-L1), with replicated binding calls
source: Adaptyv Bio binder-design competition rounds, published via proteinbase.com. Labels derived on 2026-10-03 from two raw exports on the MUNI share: 00_source_data/proteinbase_all_data_28_01_2026.csv (egfr, il7r, pd-l1) and 00_source_data/proteinbase_collection_nipah-binder-competition-results.csv (nipah). See that directory's README.md and PROVENANCE.md.
label_meaning: 1 = measured binder, 0 = measured non-binder, derived from the raw exports' `evaluations` long-format records (type=experimental, metric=binding) aggregated over replicates by majority -- median 6 replicates per (design, target). n_binding_replicates and replicates_disagree carry that per row; 7 of 2018 pairs have replicates that disagree. `expressed` is aggregated per DESIGN, not per (design, target): it records whether the protein was produced at all, which cannot differ by the target it was screened against.
caveats: FOUR. (1) 'Adaptyv' and 'ProteinBase' are ONE dataset, not two corroborating ones -- proteinbase.com publishes the Adaptyv competition results, and the share's adaptyv_662 and proteinbase_175 directories are two refold batches over the same designs (75.6% overlap), so their near-identical AUCs were close to tautological rather than independent replication. (2) Only 563 of these 2018 designs were scored by all three refold engines (egfr 190/826, il7r 96/96, nipah 211/1030, pd-l1 66/66). Every published macro-AUC from this pool, including consensus_iptm_mean 0.7113, is computed on that 563 subset, and coverage was never random, so a figure recomputed on all 2018 is not comparable. n_engines_scored records it per design. (3) Non-expressed designs are labelled non-binders (208 of 2018 are expressed=False). On the 563 subset this is 20 of 305 negatives and excluding them moves consensus_iptm_mean by -0.002 (0.7113 -> 0.7093), so it is immaterial HERE -- but the identical conflation on our own 125-design CALCA panel is 11 of 26 negatives and moves that AUC by ~0.22. Do not carry the 'immaterial' finding to a smaller pool. The expressed column ships so the filter is available. (4) DO NOT take labels from 00_source_data/master_designs.csv -- its flat binding/kd columns are unreliable. The exports are long-format per (design, target) with replicates, and flattening to one row per design silently picks a target and a replicate. 113 designs (4.5%) were counter-screened against a second target, so a wrong pick yields a chimeric row. The visible symptom: master_designs.csv shows nipah-glycoprotein-g with 927 designs and 1 binder (0.1%) because the nipah competition also screened against human-serum-albumin and the flat file picked the wrong call. These labels are built from `evaluations` instead and were verified against it on 2026-10-03: 2018/2018 matched, and the two egfr/il7r rows that disagreed with the older flat-file build were corrected (binders 323 -> 325). master_designs.csv was also wrong on expression: 1795/223 against the export's 1810/208.
